packageInternalNotExported.note: Per ADR §5 (normative), the C++/LLVM TargetRecipeProvider interface NEVER crosses the boundary — it and the recipe runtime move INSIDE the package. So NeutrinoRecipe + these headers are package-internal (BUNDLED as a package-owned build input), NOT a public-core dependency and NOT a Neutrino::Recipe link edge from the installed core. The standalone skeleton compiles the sources below as an OBJECT library whose objects are FOLDED into the backend archive ($<TARGET_OBJECTS:>) — it is NOT a linked or exported target, so the installed targets surface exposes no recipe-runtime name (a private implementation detail, not public package topology). Asserted by check_standalone_configure.sh over the emitted NeutrinoBackendPostgresTargets.cmake.
